conventions.classification: Policy classification, independent of current visibility. No UI or behavior change is implied.
conventions.null: Not applicable / no F6 control or bound; typed geometry has no F6-imposed min/max/step.
conventions.bounds: min/max/default use stored units; step uses displayed +/- increment unless stepMeaning says otherwise.
conventions.labels: Literal source label, list of exact variants, or a documented dynamic pattern; null means no F6 label.
conventions.fields: Public instance persisted fields only; constants and computed properties are not persisted. Defaults come from new instances before migration/startup.
conventions.actions: One record per command, link or repeated command family; targets/rowLabels identify repeated rows. Action default null means no stored default.
conventions.scope: Settings.xml and TripleScreen.xml field/default drift is automatic; F6 labels/ranges/actions are source-audited, not rendered or device-qualified.
conventions.actionFiles: Action file is null when it has no single persisted settings file; source identifies the implementation. Targets identify changed fields; shared drafts use dbce-controls.ini.
